quote: Any motor vehicle may be equipped with one or more backup lamps either separately or in combination with other lamps. Backup lamps shall not be lighted when the vehicle is in forward motion.

activation.condition: Qualifying motor vehicle has one or more backup lamps and is in actual forward motion.

obligation.description: Backup lamps shall not be lighted during forward motion.

permission.description: A motor vehicle may have one or more backup lamps, separate or combined with other lamps; installation is optional.

timing.description: Every actual forward-motion interval; no invented transition allowance.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Native reverse-light state is a source observation; actual emitted rear-lamp pixels need independent original-camera review.

parameter_refs.name: installed_backup_lamps
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none or one inventoried lamp for these exact comparisons; statute permits one or more, separately or combined

parameter_refs.name: command_backup_lamp_on
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: off/on Native request; actual Native readback and emitted pixels measured separately
